owner_decisions.home: the Macro Intelligence Platform package and the UIP Watchtower, beside the recession indicator
owner_decisions.consensus_factors: labelled substitutes: v1.0-R uses a trailing P/E premium from SEC filings for factor 5 and Yahoo's 90-day estimate trend (archived daily from first collection) for factor 7; strict v1.0 stays BLOCKED until a licensed point-in-time consensus archive exists

composite: ABI = sum(weight * factor_score); factor scores are 0/25/50/75/100; full precision, rounded for display only
missing_rule: a missing or UNDEFINED factor is never scored as zero; the composite is withheld (status INCOMPLETE) unless every factor of the version is present

capex_vs_revenue_growth.computation: for each company: YoY growth of standalone quarterly CapEx and of quarterly revenue (latest filed fiscal quarter vs the same fiscal quarter a year earlier); ratio = mean CapEx growth / mean revenue growth (equal-weight arithmetic means)

capex_intensity.computation: mean of each company's latest standalone quarterly CapEx / quarterly revenue, in percent

semis_inventory_build.computation: mean YoY growth of quarter-end inventory (vs the comparable prior-year quarter-end) minus mean YoY growth of quarterly revenue

mag7_concentration.computation: current: the seven companies' combined weight in the S&P 500 from the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) daily holdings, both Alphabet share classes summed (official, float-adjusted). History (backtest only): combined market capitalization / summed market capitalization of the current S&P 500 members, from SEC shares outstanding and month-end prices (survivorship-biased reconstruction, labelled)

forward_pe_premium.computation: v1.0: current forward P/E / own 10-year average forward P/E - 1, averaged. BLOCKED: no licensed point-in-time consensus archive

research_substitute.computation: for each company: month-end price / trailing-twelve-month diluted EPS from SEC filings (split-adjusted, as filed by that date), divided by the mean of its own month-end trailing P/E over the previous 120 months (at least 60 months required) - 1; averaged over companies with positive TTM EPS (at least 2 of 3)

forward_pe_premium.undefined: zero or negative EPS for a company -> that company is UNDEFINED; fewer than 2 defined companies -> factor UNDEFINED

nasdaq100_breadth.computation: share of current Nasdaq-100 members whose last close is above their 200-trading-day simple moving average (members with fewer than 200 closes are excluded and counted)

eps_revisions.computation: v1.0: next-12-month EPS consensus / archived consensus 90 days earlier - 1, averaged. BLOCKED: no licensed archive

research_substitute.computation: for each company: Yahoo earningsTrend current-year (0y) and next-year (+1y) EPS estimates now and 90 days ago, blended to a next-12-month figure by the share of the current fiscal year remaining; revision = NTM now / NTM 90 days ago - 1; averaged. Available only from the first collection day onward (archived in state/)

band_rule: bands are [low, high, score, kind]; default kind is low-inclusive, high-exclusive ([low, high)); 'closed' is [low, high]; 'open_low' is (low, high); 'open_low_closed_high' is (low, high]; null means unbounded. Together they cover every real number exactly once (tested).
label_rule: 0-20 inclusive is VERY_HEALTHY; every other label is (low, high]
labels_status: heuristic descriptions of model output, not calibrated probabilities

history.point_in_time: fundamentals use only facts filed on or before the month-end; prices use closes on or before it
history.variant: ABI-H6: factors 1-6 of v1.0-R with factor 7's weight removed and the other weights rescaled to sum to 1 (factor 7 has no history before collection began). For the backtest only; never shown as the current score

targets: QQQ maximum drawdown over the next 12 months
tests: Spearman rank correlation of ABI-H6 at month-end with each target (overlapping monthly samples; reported with a block-bootstrap 90% interval, 12-month blocks)
Mean target by ABI-H6 tercile (low, middle, high)
Each QQQ drawdown of 20% or more since 2013: ABI-H6 in the 12 months before its peak
Months at 60+ (Speculative or worse) not followed by a 15% QQQ drawdown within 12 months (false alarms)
evaluation.warning_value_claim: the page may say the index 'has historically preceded weaker technology returns' only if the 12-month return correlation is at or below -0.20 with a bootstrap interval excluding zero, AND the high tercile's mean 12-month drawdown is deeper than the low tercile's. Otherwise it says the backtest found no reliable warning value. Either way it is never framed as a crash probability or timing signal

legacy_observations: docs/abi_legacy_observations.json (unverified; never merged with the computed series)
